description: This Dart file defines the ListDatabase class, which manages CRUD operations for a 'list' data model within a SQLite database using sqflite. It includes methods for initializing the database, creating tables, inserting, reading, updating, and deleting list entries, as well as closing the database connection.

classes.name: ListDatabase
classes.description: Singleton class providing database access and CRUD operations for list data.

methods.name: database
methods.description: Getter that initializes and returns the singleton database instance.

methods.name: _initDB
methods.description: Initializes the database file at specified path and opens connection.

methods.name: _createDB
methods.description: Creates the database tables, specifically 'list' notes.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Inserts a new list record into the database.

methods.name: readNote
methods.description: Reads a list record by its ID from the database.

methods.name: readAllNotes
methods.description: Fetches all list records from the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a list record by its ID.
